purpose: prospectively instrument trait information as an exportable held-out prediction axis for unseen taxa
scientific_question: does a measured taxon trait improve held-out state prediction for taxa excluded from fitting, beyond a common environmental predictor?

data_generating_process.heldout_taxon_rule: every third ordered taxon beginning at index 1; the remaining taxa train
data_generating_process.environment_grid: 41 equally spaced values from -2.0 to +2.0 shared identically by every taxon
data_generating_process.reason_common_environment_grid: trait information cannot earn predictive gain merely by proxying a taxon-specific environment distribution

learners.full_model: logit P(Y=1) = intercept + beta_environment * environment + beta_trait * trait
learners.fitting: unpenalized maximum-likelihood logistic regression with deterministic Newton iterations

null_world_specificity_gate.interpretation: null specificity protects the traits axis from generic extra-parameter optimism

claim_boundary.pass_may_support: a measured taxon trait can carry transferable predictive information for unseen taxa in the frozen known-truth design
pass_does_not_support: causal trait effects from observational data

oracle_calibration.calculation: expected Bernoulli KL on heldout taxa between the true trait-conditioned probability and the training-taxon marginal probability at each frozen environment value
oracle_calibration.reason: the frozen positive mean-gain threshold requires recovery of roughly half the known-truth oracle trait information rather than an arbitrary near-zero effect
